# Fallout 76 Patch Notes March 17, 2026 Hotfix Update

![Fallout 76 Patch Notes March 17, 2026 Hotfix Update](/uploads/662_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

# Fallout 76 Patch Notes – March 17, 2026

March 17, 2026

Today we're releasing a patch to improve your experience in Appalachia.
### Hey Vault Dwellers,

Today we're releasing an update on some of the issues brought to our attention by the community following the release of The Hinterlands update.

## Gameplay

- Fixed a bug that caused the Chainsaw Flamethrower to hit the target too quickly, causing more damage than intended.
- Fixed a bug that caused the Incendiary Beast Queen to be one-hit killed by reflected damage.
## Pip Boy

- Fixed a bug that prevented players from setting the amount of items using a shortcut when dropping items.
- Fixed a bug that prevented players from properly closing their Pip-Boy using the “B” button.
- Fixed a bug that prevented the scrolling feature from automatically jumping back to the top of the list once it reached the end.
- Fixed a bug that caused the inventory sorting feature to always reset to default when exiting Pip-Boy.
- Fixed a bug where power armor could be put back into the storage crate while in use using the Pip-Boy New tab.
## User Interface

- The key assignment for opening the season menu has been changed from “Ctrl” to “Y” on PC.
- Various mutation effects with misleading names have had their names changed.
## Other

- Fixed a bug that caused Emotes, Loot Bags and Survival Tents to be dropped every time the game was started.
- Players will no longer receive constant “waiting for server response” notifications when there are no server issues.
- Fixed a bug that prevented players from collecting DNA from the Blazebeast Queen during the daily mission “The Heart of the Enemy.”
- Fixed instances where the game could crash when salvaging legendary items or using a workbench.

Source: bethesda.net
